decision_rule.rule: Tuned Dagu qualifies only if marked failed and retried to success within 150 seconds with checkpoint reuse and zero owned processes, with default attribution retained and no scenario-A regression. Require a surviving host to complete within 150 seconds with checkpoint reuse, no duplicate completed.json, zero descendants on every host and bounded subprocess cancellation. Equal results retain ordinary PostgreSQL plus Dagu.

Reject lost checkpoints, duplicate in-scope effects, ineffective cancellation or missed 150-second recovery. Conductor must improve the retained process/setup burden at equal recovery; rank resident process count, then setup-command count, then median recovery milliseconds. Exact ties retain the qualified path.
